description: This file defines a ProductSearch class for full-text search indexing and querying of product items within an e-commerce context, utilizing the Whoosh library and Frappe framework.

classes.name: ProductSearch
classes.description: A class extending FullTextSearch to implement product-specific search indexing and querying functionalities.

methods.name: get_schema
methods.description: Defines the search index schema with fields for title, name, path, content, and keywords.

methods.name: get_id
methods.description: Returns the identifier field for the index, which is 'name'.

methods.name: get_items_to_index
methods.description: Retrieves all published items to be indexed, including static pages and published documents.

methods.name: get_document_to_index
methods.description: Creates a document dictionary for indexing from an item, extracting relevant fields and content.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a full-text search over the index with optional scope and limit parameters.

methods.name: parse_result
methods.description: Formats a search result into a dictionary with highlights and metadata.
